description: This file defines the tlUser class which manages user-related operations in the TestLink project. It includes methods for user creation, reading from the database, role management, authentication, password handling, security checks, and utility functions relevant to user management within the testing platform.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class that handles user operations such as creation, retrieval, role management, authentication, and security within the TestLink platform.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the user object, loads configuration, and sets default values.

methods.name: _clean
methods.description: Resets the user object's properties to default values.

methods.name: isPasswordMgtExternal
methods.description: Determines if password management is handled externally (e.g., LDAP).

methods.name: generatePassword
methods.description: Generates a secure password with specified length and complexity.

methods.name: readFromDB
methods.description: Fetches user details from the database based on the user ID, login, or email.

methods.name: readTestProjectRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the roles assigned to a user for specific test projects.

methods.name: readTestPlanRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the roles assigned to a user for specific test plans.

methods.name: writeToDB
methods.description: Inserts or updates the user record in the database.

methods.name: deleteFromDB
methods.description: Deletes the user and associated roles from the database (deprecated and risky).

methods.name: deleteTestProjectRoles
methods.description: Deletes the user's roles for test projects from the database.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly display name based on the format.

methods.name: encryptPassword
methods.description: Encrypts a password using PHP's password_hash.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets and encrypts the user's password.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the user's encrypted password.

methods.name: comparePassword
methods.description: Verifies a provided password against the stored password.

methods.name: checkDetails
methods.description: Validates user details such as email and login.

methods.name: checkLogin
methods.description: Validates the login string against format and length constraints.

methods.name: hasRight
methods.description: Checks if user has a specific role/right within a test project or plan.

methods.name: getAccessibleTestPlans
methods.description: Retrieves test plans accessible to the user within a project based on roles.

methods.name: checkEmailAddress
methods.description: Validates email address format.

methods.name: doesUserExist
methods.description: Checks if a user with the given login exists.

methods.name: getByID
methods.description: Retrieves a user object by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all users with optional filtering, ordering, and detail level.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the user's active status.

methods.name: writePasswordToDB
methods.description: Stores the user's password in the database, updating cookie string if needed.

methods.name: auth_generate_cookie_string
methods.description: Generates a 64-character string for cookie-based authentication.

methods.name: auth_is_cookie_string_unique
methods.description: Checks if a cookie string is unique in the database.

methods.name: auth_generate_unique_cookie_string
methods.description: Generates a unique cookie string for user sessions.

methods.name: auth_get_current_user_cookie
methods.description: Retrieves the current user cookie from browser cookies.

methods.name: auth_is_cookie_valid
methods.description: Validates if a cookie string represents an active session.

methods.name: getSecurityCookie
methods.description: Returns the security cookie string for the user.

methods.name: hasRoleOnTestProject
methods.description: Checks if user has a role on a specific test project.

methods.name: hasRoleOnTestPlan
methods.description: Checks if user has a role on a specific test plan.

methods.name: getByAPIKey
methods.description: Retrieves a user by API key.

methods.name: checkGUISecurityClearance
methods.description: Checks if user has the necessary rights in the GUI context and enforces security.

methods.name: checkPasswordQuality
methods.description: Validates whether a password meets security requirements.

methods.name: setExpirationDate
methods.description: Sets the expiration date for a user's account.

methods.name: hasRightWrap
methods.description: Wrapper for hasRight with context.

methods.name: hasRightOnProj
methods.description: Checks if user has rights on the current project stored in session.
